premises.text: Hearing loss is widespread and undertreated; clinic hearing aids are burdensome, costly, and unattractive
premises.evidence_span: 650 million people worldwide can't. They're suffering of hearing loss. And only 1 out of 40 gets treated

premises.text: A smartphone app calibrates headphones and runs tone tests to diagnose hearing loss at home
premises.evidence_span: we took the whole audiology setup and process and squeezed it into a smartphone

premises.text: The phone's mic, processor, and speakers deliver personalized hearing enhancement for digital audio and ambient sound
premises.evidence_span: The smartphone has all the components of a hearing aid. It has a microphone. It has a processor and it has speakers

premises.text: A dedicated smart hearing enhancer uses the phone only for setup and occasional fine-tuning
premises.evidence_span: we're developing a dedicated smart hearing enhancer where the phone is only used for the initial setup and for fine tuning from time to time

premises.text: Cloud connection enables remote settings changes with guidance and improves fitting algorithms from multi-user data
premises.evidence_span: you connect it to the cloud and that enables you to change the settings wherever and whenever while getting guidance from MIMI

premises.text: Monetization is free basic app, $5/month premium cloud, and $40 subscription for the dedicated earpiece with insurance
premises.evidence_span: The basic version of the app is for free. The premium version with the cloud support comes for $5 a month

value.text: Accessible, affordable, attractive hearing enhancement people can start in the living room
value.evidence_span: making hearing enhancement more accessible by really lowering the entry barrier

causal_links.evidence_span: bringing it into the living room
We make it more affordable and better by optimizing the distribution and fitting process

notes: Prevalence, clinic burden/cost/uncoolness, and younger demographics folded as one undertreatment problem set (§4.1.6). App calibration/tone test and phone enhancement cascade folded with dedicated device and cloud fitting as one product stack with separately emphasized hardware and cloud modules kept in the same learnable hearing-product domain. Price tiers kept as one commercial premise (§4.1.3). Anti-template: problem, product, and monetization separately revisable.
